p: time shall Michael stand up: The angel here notes two things: first that the Church will be in great affliction and trouble at Christ's coming, and next that God will send his angel to deliver it, whom he here calls Michael, meaning Christ, who is proclaimed by the preaching of the Gospel.

of them that sleep in the: Meaning all will rise at the general resurrection, which thing he here names because the faithful should always consider that: for in the earth there will be no sure comfort.
wise shall shine as the brightness: Who have kept the true fear of God and his religion.
turn many to righteousness as the: He chiefly means the ministers of God's word, and next all the faithful who instruct the ignorant, and bring them to the true knowledge of God.
shut up the words: Even though the most part despise this prophecy, yet make sure you keep it and esteem it as a treasure.

even to the time of the: Until the time that God has appointed for the full revelation of these things: and then many will run to and fro to search for the knowledge of these mysteries, which things they obtain now by the light of the Gospel.
right hand and his left hand: Which was as it were a double oath, and did the more confirm the thing.
time: Meaning, a long time, a longer time, and at length a short time: signifying that their troubles would have an end.
to scatter the power of the: When the Church will be scattered and diminished in such a way as it will seem to have no power.
daily sacrifice shall be taken away: From the time that Christ by his sacrifice will take away the sacrifices and ceremonies of the Law.
shall be a thousand two hundred: Signifying that the time will be long until Christ's second coming, and yet the children of God ought not to be discouraged, even though it is deferred.

five and thirty days: In this number he adds a month and a half to the former number, signifying that it is not in man to appoint the time of Christ's coming, but that they are blessed that patiently wait for his appearing.

thou thy way till the end: The angel warns the Prophet patiently to wait, until the time appointed comes, signifying that he should depart this life, and rise again with the elect, when God had sufficiently humbled and purged his Church.
